description: Restores the values that one batch changed, within 24 hours of the batch. Accounts changed again after the batch are skipped and listed with the reason, so a later edit is never overwritten. A batch can be reverted once. Applies when the user wants to undo a bulk change. 繁中：24 小時內復原一批變更，之後又被改過的帳號會跳過。
name: revert_account_settings_batch
title: Undo a bulk settings batch
